hard_validation_attempt_1.text: The tavern runner wipes his hands on his stained apron before ladling a thick, steaming stew into a chipped wooden bowl. His voice lowers to a whisper as he glances around the crowded gate area. "Word is the missing patrol encountered something unexpected beyond the northwest mud track," he says cautiously. "No one's sure what, but it's got the guard captain worried enough to tighten the curfew and post warnings on that notice board over there." He jerks a thumb toward the board listing the new taxes, curfew rules, and the patrol's disappearance. "Crowd's tense, talking in hushed tones. Rumors fly, but most stick to what the guard serjeant lets slip when he thinks no one's listening."

The mood's tense; folk are keeping close, eyes flicking nervously toward the woods."

Some say it might be tied to the rising tension, maybe someone wanting to stir trouble—but that's just idle talk around here. If you want answers, the gate serjeant tends to keep better records and watch the notices."

He glances nervously toward the gate serjeant managing the crowd while lowering his voice, signaling his hesitance to share more openly.
